scripts.build: pnpm --filter @portfolio-mcp/admin-contracts build && pnpm --filter @portfolio-mcp/backend build && pnpm --filter @portfolio-mcp/console build
scripts.start:dev: portfolio-config run --app portfolio-mcp --env development -- node apps/backend/dist/bootstrap/server.js
scripts.start:prod: portfolio-config run --app portfolio-mcp --env production -- node apps/backend/dist/bootstrap/server.js
scripts.check:storage: portfolio-config run --app portfolio-mcp --env development -- node scripts/check-bucket-private.mjs
scripts.check:storage:prod: portfolio-config run --app portfolio-mcp --env production -- node scripts/check-bucket-private.mjs
